concerns.text: The plan schedules a hierarchical bootstrap with 10 000 iterations per species (≈30 species) and three SDM algorithms, which is unlikely to complete within the GitHub Actions free‑tier limits (2 CPU cores, ~7 GB RAM, ≤ 6 h). This exceeds the compute budget and may cause timeouts or memory exhaustion. Reduce the number of bootstrap iterations, limit the species set, or provide a fallback strategy to ensure the pipeline can finish within the allocated resources.
